aboutGame.title: What is Groundwork Simulator?
paragraphs: Groundwork Simulator is an open-world heavy machinery game focused on excavation, earthmoving, transportation, gold mining, terrain shaping, and wash plant construction. It supports cooperative play for up to four players.
Our wiki explains the workflow from site preparation to processing: choose the right machine, plan haul routes, find gold-bearing ground, and build a wash plant that can keep pace with your crew.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Groundwork Simulator.

items.question: What is Groundwork Simulator?
items.answer: Groundwork Simulator is an open-world heavy machinery game about excavation, earthmoving, gold mining, terrain shaping, transportation, and building wash plants. It supports cooperative play for up to four players.

items.question: Is Groundwork Simulator multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. The game is designed for cooperative play with up to four players, so crews can divide excavation, hauling, and processing tasks.

items.question: What platform is Groundwork Simulator on?
items.answer: The official store listing is for PC on Steam. Check the Steam page for current system requirements and availability.

items.question: How do I mine gold?
items.answer: Prospect for gold-bearing ground, extract the ore-bearing material, haul it to a processing area, and feed it through a wash plant at a steady rate.

items.question: Does Groundwork Simulator have codes?
items.answer: No verified active codes are currently available. Check the Codes page for future updates and only use codes confirmed by official channels.

bosses.overviewDescription: Complete guides for every boss encounter in Groundwork Simulator 13 bosses from the tutorial knight Gelum to endgame encounters like the Gelid Dweller and Gauntlet challenges.
bosses.body: Bosses in Groundwork Simulator serve as skill gates and progression milestones. Some, like Gelum, teach you the combat fundamentals during the tutorial. Others, such as the Shikai Spirit and Resurreccion Spirit, are inner-world encounters tied directly to your race's power unlock. Area bosses like Dragonfly, King Croc, and Securis guard access to new zones and rewards. Recent additions include the Rogue Commander with his Minions, the ice-themed The Everfrosted, and four brand new endgame bosses: The Gelid Dweller, Cinder of the Broken Sky, Devourer of Hosts, and the Wandering Swordsman (Junichiro). Each boss has distinct attack patterns and telegraphed moves you need to learn. Use the guides below to prepare for every fight.
